[← All research areas](research.qmd)

Multiple access lets several users share the resources of a communication system. We study NOMA, SCMA and RSMA, compare their performance and investigate resource allocation among users.

Our work examines user signal processing and separation, and how resource allocation affects throughput and communication quality.
